# Compiler Explorer probes of hlsl_clang_trunk for #3092, with controls.
#
# SKILL.md: "A Clang error is not evidence until you have a control." Clang's
# HLSL/DXIL support is incomplete, so it fails on inputs that have nothing to
# do with the issue. Cases 2-3 are the controls that isolate case 1.
#
# Produced by:  python ce-probe.py <source> hlsl_clang_trunk
# hlsl_clang_trunk is a rolling build; the class of failure is the evidence,
# not the exact build.
